caption: The drawing depicts a square textile within a beige background, featuring an ornate border with a repeating pattern of pink and brown stylized flowers on a green background. Inside the border, the central area has a cream or off-white base with a subtle diagonal crosshatch texture. The composition includes a large brown eagle with outstretched wings at the center, perched atop a blue and brown shield-like object. Surrounding the eagle are various arrangements of flowers and baskets. Below the eagle is a large basket overflowing with a colorful assortment of flowers in shades of pink, red, blue, yellow, and green. Green leafy vines, arranged in gracefully curving arcs, frame the central motifs, and several smaller baskets of flowers are distributed symmetrically around the field. Birds of various hues, including shades of blue, brown, and yellow, are interspersed among the flowers and vines. Some stars and smaller floral elements are scattered throughout, providing additional detail. The artwork uses a palette mainly composed of muted reds, pinks, blues, greens, browns, and yellows.
title: Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
